blocks.x: The Right People, a Solid Structure
What determines an organization's fate is not product, capital, or technology; it is the people within that structure.
This service focuses on finding human resources that fit your company's goals, placing them in the right positions, and building a sustainable management structure.
It is concerned not only with resumes but with character, culture, and potential. Because the right person is not just hired; they are placed in the right position.
Approach: Experience + Intuition + System
The method we use in the recruitment process differs from classic human resources templates.
Every country has different culture, ways of doing business, and professional reflexes.
Recruitment done without understanding these differences does not last long.
Over the years, thousands of interviews have been conducted in very different markets, from Europe to Asia, from Eastern Europe to the Middle East.
In some places, sales representatives were selected, in others marketing managers, and in others general managers.
Sometimes it was not just about building a team; entire companies were built from scratch, from accounting to logistics, from secretary to field team.
This experience taught us:
What keeps an organization standing is not technical competence on a CV, but the energy of a person who fits harmoniously into the system.
Process: Not Just Selecting, but Building

items: Needs Definition: A map of roles, responsibilities, and competencies is created according to the organization's goals.
Profile Definition: Cultural fit, leadership potential, and the characteristic needs of the position are defined.
Candidate Screening and Interview: Both technical competence and personality fit are evaluated through multi-stage interviews.
Team Design: Team balance is created with the complementary aspects of selected individuals.
Administrative Structuring: Organizational chart, authority boundaries, reporting chains, and internal communication protocols are designed.

blocks.x: The goal is not just to hire, but to build a system.
Cross-Cultural People Management
Recruitment in a country is done not just by knowing the language but by understanding the culture.
In some markets, discipline is at the forefront, while in others, relationships and trust are decisive.
Knowing how to read these differences is the shortest path to finding the right person.

This is where the greatest strength of this service lies: the competence to quickly analyze human behavior and business culture thanks to the observation, intuition, and management experience gained while building hundreds of organizations in different geographies over the years.

For example; while in Southeast Asia it is necessary to build a vertical structure for hardworking but highly hierarchical field teams, in Central Asia horizontal organizations that strengthen team spirit yield more efficient results.
Knowing these nuances provides not only cultural awareness but operational success.
What You Get

items: Position-based recruitment plan and interview system
Organizational chart, job descriptions, and authority distribution
Performance measurement and development plan infrastructure
"Organizational stabilization" follow-up for the first 3 months
